# Christina Nortman, CPA
> Professional profile of Christina Nortman, CPA -- Northeast region lead at AE Tax Advisors.

## About
Christina Nortman is a Certified Public Accountant who leads AE Tax Advisors' Northeast region. She specializes in proactive tax planning, cost segregation studies, entity structuring, and strategic advisory services for business owners, real estate investors, and high-income professionals. Christina works with clients across multiple states through the firm's virtual advisory model.
